# gitmoap_repository_forks (Data Source)

List a repository's forks. The forks of this repository that you can see, newest first unless you choose another order: its own forks, or with `scope=network` every fork descended from the same original. A fork names its upstream, and how many forks it sits from the original, only where you can see that upstream, and nothing says how many forks you cannot see. `search` matches a fork's path. Page with `next_token`.

The token needs `repo:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `scope` (String) `children` (the default): this repository's own forks. `network`: every fork descended from the same original
- `search` (String) Only forks whose path contains this
- `sort` (String) `newest` (the default), `recently_pushed` or `most_starred`

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The forks on this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `ahead` (Number) As of `as_of`: commits the tracked branch has that its upstream branch lacks.
- `as_of` (String) When `ahead` and `behind` were last counted.
- `behind` (Number) As of `as_of`: commits the upstream branch has that the tracked branch lacks.
- `created_at` (String) When the fork was created.
- `depth` (Number) Forks between this one and the root, when you can see its upstream.
- `full_path` (String)
- `kind` (String) `bound`: a fork of private code, or a private fix fork — only people who can read the repositories it is bound to can read it, and it never leaves its upstream's organization. `independent`: a fork of a public or internal repository, whose audience is its own within its visibility ceiling.
- `pushed_at` (String) When the fork last changed.
- `repository_id` (String)
- `stars` (Number) How many people starred the fork.
- `upstream_id` (String)
- `visibility` (String)
